reviews.text: She was nice to my dog and helped me with a short visit. Will definitely go see her again!
An exceptional vet who genuinely cares and has the animals’ best interests at heart

Tuisku passed away today to dog heaven after thorough consideration and monitoring supported by Sanna. Beautifully, peacefully and with love. Sanna was Tuisku's familiar veterinarian throughout his life of over 16 years. Thank you Sanna for all the help we could rely on and rely on over the years.

Nanna was taken to the Rainbow Bridge in my arms with the help of Sanna, peacefully at our home. Sanna first explained expertly how the final service would proceed and what would be done. Thank you Sanna for your empathy and the way you handled this sad task. ❤️🐾 …

What I go to for my dog's treatment is very good and the doctor is really nice. The dog gave him a kiss when he examined him and always goes there straight from outside.
Nice place to visit
